title: Communication-Efficient Distributionally Robust Federated Averaging with Multi-Source Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.20060v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning trains a shared model from distributed client data. The deployment risk is typically specified through two approximations: each unknown local distribution is replaced by its empirical distribution, and the unknown deployment mixture across clients is replaced by empirical or prescribed training weights. Existing robust methods usually address one approximation at a time through local distributional ambiguity sets or worst-case client mixtures. However, joint treatment of both approximations remains underexplored. To address this gap, we construct a global ambiguity set formed by admissible mixtures of client-wise Wasserstein ambiguity sets, yielding a distributionally robust optimization formulation. The construction allows client-dependent ambiguity radii, preserves client-wise separability of the objective function, and yields a high-probability out-of-sample guarantee for the resulting robust problem. translated_title: 基于多源数据的通信高效分布鲁棒联邦平均
translated_abstract: 联邦学习利用分布式客户端数据训练共享模型。部署风险通常通过两个近似来刻画：用经验分布替代每个未知的本地分布，用经验或预设的训练权重替代客户端之间未知的部署混合。现有的鲁棒方法通常每次只处理其中一个近似，即要么通过本地分布模糊集，要么通过最坏情况的客户端混合。然而，对这两个近似的联合处理仍未得到充分探索。为弥补这一空白，我们构建了一个由客户端级Wasserstein模糊集的可容许混合所形成的全局模糊集，从而得到一个分布鲁棒优化形式。该构造允许使用与客户端相关的模糊半径，保持了目标函数的客户端级可分离性，并为所得的鲁棒问题提供了高概率的样本外保证。我们随后引入（原文摘要在此处截断）...
tldr: 该论文提出通过构建由客户端级Wasserstein模糊集的可容许混合形成的全局模糊集，首次在分布鲁棒联邦平均框架下联合处理本地分布与客户端部署混合这两重近似不确定性，同时支持客户端级模糊半径、保持目标函数可分离性并提供高概率样本外保证，且算法具备通信高效性。
